policy.compatibility: Lumen 4 may deliberately replace v3 component and binary contracts. Consumer data, privacy, and release approval remain protected. Migration guidance documents externally visible changes.
policy.versioning: Prepare the coordinated v4 candidate locally. Publication requires separate approval of the final reviewed revision through the existing GitHub release workflow.

changes.currentContract: Consumers carry chart-label, hidden-state, clipboard, date-selection, and native-layout workarounds across older Lumen releases.
changes.replacement: Shared chart geometry and formatted axes, strict range selection, explicit clipboard recovery, accessible native layout controls, and a cross-framework image comparison primitive.
changes.migration: Use stable unique chart X identities; remove verified old chart/hidden patches; review button content selectors and loading activation; rebuild native consumers for changed initializer and formatter contracts.

changes.currentContract: Eight v3 Swift initializer signatures do not expose compact chart, heatmap color scales, chart-data labels and formatting, slider-label, and symbol-selection options. The v3 icon enum lacks four reviewed catalog additions.
changes.replacement: Defaulted parameters provide bare chart frames, explicit plot height, heatmap color scales and legends, localized interval-chart data and formatting, optional slider headings, contextual symbol tint, and selection completion. The icon enum adds bangladeshiTaka, layoutGridCircles, letters, and printer3d.
changes.migration: Rebuild consumers against v4. Existing source calls generally retain defaults; method references and binary clients must adopt the new signatures. Exhaustive LumenIconName switches must handle the four new cases or provide an appropriate fallback. See native composition examples and the v4 migration guide.

changes.currentContract: SwiftUI and Compose sheets wrap unbounded content without configurable dismissal protection; native required-field and tab-panel descriptions include fixed English text.
changes.replacement: Native sheet scroll and dismissal policies, keyboard-safe content, compact-height and large-text fallbacks, explicit React Native focus targets, and caller-localized accessibility descriptions.
changes.migration: Rebuild SwiftUI and Compose consumers for the new sheet signatures. Set scrollable false for application-owned lazy or virtualized content. Supply translated requiredLabel and panelAccessibilityLabel in Compose and React Native when needed.

changes.currentContract: Embedded Lumen MCP integrations import SDK v1 server and transport objects.
changes.replacement: The embedded server uses SDK v2 server, client and transport packages.
changes.migration: Migrate known SDK module paths, update SDK dependencies to compatible v2 packages, rebuild and test the real transport. Other SDK imports require manual review.

changes.currentContract: Theme palettes and surface dimensions are customized separately in each adapter. Swift surface and theme initializer signatures do not expose appearance or material options.
changes.replacement: Canonical Default, Studio and Glass appearances, scoped web tokens, ThemeBuilder dimensions and explicit surface material with native opaque fallbacks.
changes.migration: Choose a preset, then override semantic tokens or native appearance values. Glass remains explicit per surface. Rebuild Swift and Compose consumers; Swift initializer references must include the defaulted appearance and material parameters.

changes.currentContract: The v3 phone initializer does not expose presentation controls.
changes.replacement: Defaulted v4 selector, display format, placeholder, flag and size options for existing phone selection behavior.
changes.migration: Rebuild Swift consumers and update initializer references for the added defaulted phone presentation parameters.

changes.currentContract: Explicit v3 Stack/Grid gaps use a separate scale; cards and reading blocks rely on child margins and clipped overflow.
changes.replacement: Canonical web gaps, parent-owned spacing, Card density and visible overflow, responsive Container gutters and trimmed reading-block margins.
changes.migration: Map literal web gaps md/lg/xl to group/xl/2xl with lumen migrate v4. Review Card density, compensating margins and clipping; put media clipping in AspectRatio. Native spacing is unchanged.

changes.currentContract: Select, PhoneInput and Segmented use size for visual density; Select also accepts the visual md alias.
changes.replacement: visualSize in Astro/React and visual-size in Elements use default, sm or lg. Native input/select size remains numeric. Elements Select uses ui-select-field for its frame and ui-select for its native input and trigger.
changes.migration: Run lumen migrate v4 for recognized literals. Change wrapper, spread and dynamic visual size props manually; map Select md to default. Keep numeric size; PhoneInput forwards it through inputProps.size. Button, icon, container and native-platform sizes are unchanged. Update Elements Select host CSS selectors from ui-select to ui-select-field.

changes.currentContract: React Segmented does not retain controlled owner state; React Select popup interactions and resets can diverge from native submission. Elements scalar reconnection, checked defaults and multiple selections can diverge from native forms.
changes.replacement: Controlled values remain owner-held; accepted resets restore defaults silently and cancelled resets retain drafts. Each documented user callback fires once. Elements retain listeners and reset defaults after relocation and submit every enabled selected option.
changes.migration: Use value/onValueChange or defaultValue deliberately. Listen on Elements hosts and use checked for current state, defaultChecked for the reset baseline. Remove compensating reset or duplicate event handlers after verifying native and external form submission.

changes.currentContract: Editable Combobox consumers may assume option buttons receive focus and parent Escape handlers always dismiss.
changes.replacement: Input focus remains stable with aria-activedescendant; nested controls consume their own Escape.
changes.migration: Update focus assertions and option styling to active-descendant/selected state. Parent handlers must honor defaultPrevented; Enter without an active option retains native form behavior.

changes.currentContract: Web PhoneInput id may be treated as a frame identifier.
changes.replacement: Astro/React id identifies the number input that receives focus; Elements retains host id and uses input-id for its input.
changes.migration: Update labels and DOM queries; use Elements input-id for the input that receives focus. Native phone contracts are covered separately.

changes.currentContract: Consumers may interpret virtual-list range endpoints as exclusive.
changes.replacement: Fixed-height windows report inclusive endpoints and endIndex -1 for empty lists. Mounted DOM remains the default; opt-in data rendering mounts visible rows and focused neighbors.
changes.migration: Update exclusive-end calculations and empty handling. Use stable unique keys and external state for opt-in data rendering; variable-height lists need a different strategy. Existing root imports remain supported; selective component imports are additive.

changes.currentContract: External editor integrations may execute commands during completion events or fall back to browser commands after failure.
changes.replacement: Cancelable ui:editor-command-request owns execution; ui:editor-command reports completion without execution.
changes.migration: External engines must preventDefault on the request and set detail.executed synchronously; React can supply commandHandler. Remove completion handlers that execute commands again. Failed external commands do not fall back.
